name: C5-4 GRPO group advantage
description: Eight rewards and their mean, no critic

data.noteContent:
GRPO's one change to PPO is the baseline. PPO trains a critic network to guess what a state is worth and subtracts that; GRPO samples the same prompt K times and subtracts the mean of the group, so a whole model leaves the training setup. The eight numbers stand in for eight sampled completions a reward model has scored, and the Mean node is the whole baseline: 0.4875. An advantage is one reward minus that number, and a group's advantages always sum to zero. This graph stops at the baseline; GroupRelativeAdvantage does the subtraction and the sum-to-zero check in one node.

GRPO 對 PPO 只改了基準這一件事。PPO 要另外訓練一個 critic 去猜某個狀態值多少，再減掉它；GRPO 則是對同一個提示採樣 K 次，減掉這一組的平均，於是整個模型從訓練流程裡消失。這裡的八個數字代表獎勵模型已經打過分的八份候選回答，而 Mean 節點就是基準的全部：0.4875。優勢是某一個獎勵減掉這個數字，同一組的優勢加起來一定是零。這張圖到基準為止；RL 分類裡的 GroupRelativeAdvantage 節點會把相減和「加起來是零」的檢查一次做完。

Real GRPO samples K completions from the policy for one prompt and has a reward model score each; these eight are typed in so the arithmetic stays visible. K matters: if every completion in a group scores the same, every advantage is zero and the group teaches nothing.

真正的 GRPO 會對同一個提示從策略採樣 K 份回答，再用獎勵模型各打一個分數；這裡的八個分數是直接填進去的，好讓算術看得見。K 的大小有差：如果一組裡每份回答分數都一樣，優勢就全是零，這一組什麼也教不了。

dim 0 averages the eight rewards, and keepdim true hands back a one-element tensor rather than a scalar; either shape broadcasts against the eight when you subtract. Nothing estimated this number: it is the average of the eight above it, so it cannot be wrong about them.

dim 設 0 表示對八個獎勵取平均，keepdim 開著會回傳只有一個元素的張量，而不是純量；相減時兩種形狀都能對那八個數廣播。這個數字不是估出來的，它就是上面那八個數的平均，所以不可能估錯。
